source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Stature (archived 20 June 2018)

powerGrid.note: Marvel filed Cassie under her codename Stature; the archived page gives her real name as Cassandra Eleanore Lang. No archived copies exist for Stature_(Cassie_Lang) or Cassie_Lang.

powerOrigins.detail: Years of secretly exposing herself to Pym Particles changed her body, so she can shrink or grow without a suit.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Young Avengers Vol 1 3

powerOrigins.detail: As Stinger she added a cybernetic helmet that commands insects and bio-synthetic wings for flight.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Astonishing Ant-Man Vol 1 7

powerOrigins.detail: Self-defence classes after being kidnapped as a child, lessons from Captain America and Wolverine, and Initiative training at Camp Hammond.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Astonishing Ant-Man Vol 1 6

abilities.name: Shrinking
abilities.detail: She can shrink to the size of an ant, about half an inch tall.

abilities.name: Growing giant
abilities.detail: She can grow to gigantic size, taking on extra mass that toughens her bones and muscles and gives her superhuman strength and durability. Her top height is about 250 feet, which she cannot hold for long.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Mighty Avengers Vol 1 24

abilities.name: Moods move her size
abilities.detail: Her powers answer to her feelings: anger has made her grow without meaning to, and guilt once shrank her almost out of existence.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Young Avengers Presents Vol 1 5

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.detail: Stinger's bio-synthetic wings let her fly.

abilities.name: Insect command
abilities.detail: Her Stinger helmet, with a boosted signal, lets her talk to and direct insects.

abilities.name: Hand-to-hand combat
abilities.detail: Better than average in a fight, from self-defence classes and training with Captain America and Wolverine.

feats.text: Believing Doctor Doom had crushed her father, she grew to enormous size and knocked Doom down while he held the Scarlet Witch's stolen power. He killed her in return.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Avengers: The Children's Crusade Vol 1 8

feats.text: In the Central Park battle that ended the Skrull invasion, she landed a giant-sized blow on the Skrull Yellowjacket.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Secret Invasion Vol 1 7

feats.text: Brought down the Growing Man on her own, though he fell on her stepfather as he went.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Young Avengers Presents Vol 1 5

feats.text: Beat the villain Macrothrax herself while her father fought off his giant Bug Lords.
Covered for her father when FBI agents searched his house while he was out, keeping them from going upstairs by saying he was ill.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: Ant-Man and the Wasp

feats.text: Escaped her Quantumnaut guards with Pym Particle discs, broke Jentorra out of her cell and took over Kang's broadcast to call the people of Axia to revolt.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania

feats.text: Cornered by M.O.D.O.K., she fed a grow disc into her suit's regulator, turned giant and punched him off his feet.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
